articles.title: PREVIEW: Blackhawks Open Home Schedule Against Blues
Kane looks to help Blackhawks get first win in return to United Center
Kane's Blackhawks homecoming sparks memories of other NHL second acts

away.summary: The St. Louis Blues are looking to rebound after splitting their first two games of the season. They will face the Chicago Blackhawks at United Center, where they have a strong historical record. The team is still finding consistency, especially offensively, with the Robert Thomas line needing more production.

home.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks are looking for their first win of the season as they host the St. Louis Blues. Patrick Kane is returning to United Center for the first time since 2023 and is expected to play a key role. The team has made several roster additions and is in a rebuilding phase, but Kane's return adds significant veteran leadership.
